/// @notice A deployless queryer that queries a target contract on a predeploy address.
/// @author Solady (https://github.com/Vectorized/solady)
contract DeploylessPredeployQueryer {
    /*´:°•.°+.*•´.*:°•°•.*:°•.°+.*•´.*:°•°•.*:°•.°+.*•´.*:°•°•.*:°•.°+.*•´.*:°•°•.*:°•.°+.*
    /*                           CUSTOM ERRORS                                                                   */
    /*.•°:°.´+°•°.×•´.*:°•°•.*:°•.°+.*•´.*:°•°•.*:°•.°+.*•´.*:°•°•.*:°•.°+.*•´.*:°•°•.*:°•.°+.*•´.*:°•°•.°•°.*/

    /// @dev The address of the deployed target does not match the expected target address.
    error ReturnedAddressMismatch();

    /*´:°•.°+.*•´.*:°•°•.*:°•.°+.*•´.*:°•°•.*:°•.°+.*•´.*:°•°•.*:°•.°+.*•´.*:°•°•.*:°•.°+.*
    /*                                    CONSTRUCTOR                                                             */
    /*.•°:°.´+°•°.×•´.*:°•°•.*:°•.°+.*•´.*:°•°•.*:°•.°+.*•´.*:°•°•.*:°•.°+.*•´.*:°•°•.*:°•.°+.*•´.*:°•°•.°•°.*/

    constructor(
        address target,
        bytes[] memory targetQueryCalldata,
        address factory,
        bytes memory factoryCalldata
    ) {
        assembly {
            // If the target does not have code, deploy it using the factory.
